<div class="scene" data-scene="START"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">A NEAR-FUTURE SURVEILLANCE THRILLER</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Probable Match</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("START") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>START</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Three matches.<br>One innocent person.<br>A very good quarter.</p> <p>A municipal investigator is dead. A camera network has a suspect. By the end of the week, the company behind it hopes to have a much larger contract.</p><p>You can be the person the system identifies, or the person paid to expand it.</p> <div class="notice"><strong>A near-future fiction.</strong> Flock Horizon, its facial and gait analysis, recoverable camera cache, characters, crime, and corporate misconduct are invented. This is not a depiction of a real executive or a claim about present Flock capabilities.</div> <p class="fine">Contains a non-graphic murder accusation, police questioning, detention, retaliation, and property destruction. Inspect highlighted objects to open evidence. Use Continue to advance dialogue or Read all to expand a scene. No timed choices. Progress can be saved on this device or exported.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("START") %> <%= PM.choices("START") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / START / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[ROLE]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="ROLE"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">A NEAR-FUTURE SURVEILLANCE THRILLER</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Choose your perspective</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("ROLE") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>ROLE</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The same evidence.<br>A different kind of power.</p><p>Each perspective starts a separate version of the incident. Your choices in one run will not secretly determine the other.</p> <p>There is no assigned moral grade. At the end, you can assess your own decisions. The story remembers what you disclosed, preserved, sacrificed, and allowed.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("ROLE") %> <%= PM.choices("ROLE") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / ROLE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C01]] [[X01]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X01"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The boardroom</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X01") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X01</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The first slide is a map. By the third, it is a revenue forecast.</p><p>“Riverton gives us the regional reference customer,” says Vale, the chair. “Close before financing and we stop explaining our potential. We price it.”</p><p>The investor director wants to know why a competitor could install faster. Finance has already budgeted the expansion. Sales has invited the mayor to a launch. Four voting directors, four versions of the same answer.</p><p>Only Imani, the independent director, asks how a resident challenges an identification. Engineer Lena Ortiz sits against the wall. She has no vote.</p><blockquote>“The combined identity assessment looks stronger than its inputs,” Lena says. “We should not sell it as three independent confirmations.”</blockquote><p>Finance turns a compensation sheet toward you: a full deal could pay you $2 million in bonus and equity; a restricted contract, $800,000. These are conditional payouts, not money already earned. “Every decision this week can move those numbers,” Vale says. “Costs, delays, disclosure, all of it. And your job is always on the line if this board decides you are underperforming.”</p><p>Vale turns back to you. “Then fix the language. We are deciding whether this company grows.”</p><div class="document"><span>BOARD PACK / NOTE 12</span><p>The existing pilot has already supplied an identity assessment to a murder investigation. Expansion revenue is included in the forecast. The safety review is not complete.</p></div> </div> <%= PM.context("X01") %> <%= PM.choices("X01") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X01 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X02]] [[X07]] [[X12]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X02"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A suspect becomes a sales story</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X02") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X02</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Sales has a new slide: <strong>HORIZON IDENTIFIES MURDER SUSPECT.</strong> Under it is Alex's face. The police have not established that Alex committed the crime.</p><p>Lena closes your office door. A plate association narrowed the candidate pool. That pool shaped which face and walking-pattern comparisons received attention. The display then presented the results as separate reasons for confidence.</p><p>“It is one assumption coming back in three different uniforms,” she says.</p><p>You ask whether the system might still have the right person. “It might. That is not what this slide claims.”</p><p>The sales director messages: <em>Need sign-off in ten. City wants something decisive.</em> You have enough information to know the difference between uncertainty and the claim you are being asked to approve.</p> <p>Earlier today, a public appeal showed Mara, the investigator’s sister, holding a family photograph. “He was meant to call on Sunday. We need an answer we can trust.” The image stays with you after the report ends.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X02") %> <%= PM.choices("X02") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X02 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X12]] [[X03]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X03"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The launch floor</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X03") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X03</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance confirms the revised plan requires $600,000 of company spending and reduces your projected payout by $400,000.</p><p>The launch floor applauds a signed installation schedule. Your photograph appears beside the word <em>momentum</em>.</p><p>There is a real success in the briefing too. A verified vehicle sighting helped police recover a mechanic's stolen work van. His tools were still inside. Without them, he could not have kept his employees working.</p><p>Lena does not dispute that. She asks for fewer installations so her team can restrict access and reduce diagnostic retention before new units go live.</p><p>Sales points at the waiting contracts. Finance points at the hiring plan. Neither says the residents do not matter. Both say their costs belong in a later quarter.</p><blockquote>“You can protect everything,” Vale tells you, “except a company with no customers.”</blockquote><p>The original pilot already holds records. Reducing new collection now will not make those earlier observations disappear.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X03") %> <%= PM.choices("X03") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X03 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X04]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X04"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A camera is destroyed</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X04") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X04</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The video arrives without sound. A crowd. A camera tilting out of frame. A hooded figure carrying the damaged unit away.</p><p>Nox, an anti-surveillance hacker, sends a message through a reporter. The unit's fictional diagnostic cache contains candidate comparisons, timestamps, and unrelated sightings. It contradicts the clean certainty in your presentation.</p><p>It does not contain your board minutes. Nox can challenge the identification; proving what management knew will require another source.</p><blockquote>“You put our lives in a box on a pole. Now you want to call opening it the danger.”</blockquote><p>Security is worried about exposed residents. Sales is worried about exposed promises. Both call this a crisis, but they are asking you to protect different things.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X04") %> <%= PM.choices("X04") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X04 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X05]] [[X06]] [[X17]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X05"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The emergency response room</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X05") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X05</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has priced an independent custody review at $250,000 in company funds. Authorizing one commits that budget, or retains it if already funded; it is separate from your personal compensation.</p> <p>The emergency response room has three screens: customer cancellations, the news, and a list of people whose records may be exposed.</p><p>“Tell them the incident is contained,” sales says. Lena asks what <em>contained</em> means if the data have already left the device.</p><p>Counsel places a preservation request in front of you. The inquiry needs original observations, comparison history, and the warning memo. Those documents could correct Alex's case. They could also establish that your company knew more than it admitted.</p><p>Vale offers a quieter route: contact Alex's representative, offer a correction, keep the technical explanation inside the company.</p><p>The phone on the table lights up again. This time it is a customer asking whether their own residents' data are safe.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X05") %> <%= PM.choices("X05") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X05 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X21]] [[X18]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X06"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Negotiating with Nox</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X06") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X06</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has priced an independent custody review at $250,000 in company funds. Authorizing one commits that budget, or retains it if already funded; it is separate from your personal compensation.</p> <p>The intermediary refuses to meet in your offices. At the library, they place two folders on the table: evidence about the identification, and movements of people unrelated to the case.</p><p>“We can protect the second without burying the first.”</p><p>Nox joins by voice. “You will call everything private if that makes everything disappear.” The intermediary asks for independent custody, a copy of the internal warning, and a commitment that the examiner can publish findings.</p><p>You could lose control over a report that changes the company's future. You could also stop treating residents' privacy as a reason to keep your own decisions secret.</p><p>Your lawyers have brought a broader confidentiality agreement. Nobody else at the table has agreed to sign it.</p> <p>Nox has contacted Imani, a resident whose journeys appear in the cache. She allowed Nox to quote her reply: “I want this challenged too. But that clinic visit was mine. Helping your case does not mean handing my movements to everyone.” Nox says the full archive would be harder to dismiss. Imani has not agreed to that release.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X06") %> <%= PM.choices("X06") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X06 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X21]] [[X17]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X07"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The city procurement meeting</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X07") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X07</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The procurement officer reads the restricted proposal twice. “You want us to pay for a system that asks permission more often?”</p><p>An investigator describes a suspect moving across jurisdictions and a search delayed by incompatible databases. A resident on the advisory panel describes a different delay: three offices unable to explain why her car kept appearing in reports.</p><p>Your restrictions would limit access, narrow sharing, and require review before biometric alerts could drive further action. They would also shrink the deal.</p><p>The city can accept a smaller pilot. The original expansion remains available if you remove the conditions.</p><blockquote>Vale's message arrives during the meeting: “Bring back the contract we forecast. Not an experiment in running a smaller company.”</blockquote><p>For the first time, the boundary is attached to a price the board can see.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X07") %> <%= PM.choices("X07") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X07 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X02]] [[X08]] [[X12]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X08"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Who pays for safeguards</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X08") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X08</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The funded plan assigns $300,000 of company money to lasting review capacity. Under the smaller installation target, your compensation forecast falls from $800,000 to $400,000.</p><p>Finance lays out two staffing plans. The installation team cannot reach the original target while the company pays for independent review, access controls, and a staffed correction process on the smaller contract.</p><p>“We can make oversight temporary,” the director says. “A launch expense. Then reconsider.”</p><p>Lena asks what happens when a complaint arrives after the temporary staff are gone. The director says the permanent team will manage. The permanent team is already behind.</p><p>There is another plan: fewer devices, fewer projected returns, full review capacity. It preserves a viable business, but removes the full-expansion award and makes the next financing conversation harder.</p><p>The spreadsheet does not have a cell for the time an innocent person spends trying to obtain an answer. You can still decide whether that time is part of the cost.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X08") %> <%= PM.choices("X08") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X08 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X09]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X09"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The engineer’s record</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X09") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X09</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has priced an independent custody review at $250,000 in company funds. Authorizing one commits that budget, or retains it if already funded; it is separate from your personal compensation.</p> <p>Lena brings a printed memo. The date is earlier than the sales announcement.</p><p>“If we keep only the final assessment, nobody can reconstruct why it changed,” she says. “The contradiction is the evidence.”</p><p>You ask whether an internal summary could explain it. She says a summary written by the people under investigation is not the same as access to originals.</p><p>Independent custody would make future deletion ineffective. It would also give Lena somewhere to speak without routing every sentence through communications.</p><p>Vale calls the proposal an unnecessary invitation to litigate the company in public. Lena keeps the memo on the table between you.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X09") %> <%= PM.choices("X09") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X09 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X10]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X10"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The pilot is breached</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X10") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X10</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>A pilot camera has been destroyed. Nox has recovered observations and comparison history from its diagnostic cache. The device was installed before your new policy existed.</p><p>The city's first question is not whether you condemn the damage. It is whether the restrictions in your contract actually protect anyone when the company has something to lose.</p><p>Lena says the cache can be checked against retained records. A public explanation could undermine the identity claim. An unredacted release could expose residents who have never heard Alex's name.</p><blockquote>“If you mean independent review,” Imani says, “this is what independence looks like when it is inconvenient.”</blockquote><p>The board's emergency meeting begins in an hour.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X10") %> <%= PM.choices("X10") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X10 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X11]] [[X17]] [[X12]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X11"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Renewal with conditions</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X11") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X11</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The city’s term sheets attach $400,000 of personal performance pay to the enforceable smaller deal, or $1.4 million to the larger renewal. Neither is earned before the agreement closes.</p><p>The city offers a revised renewal. The smaller option requires independent access, funded complaint support, and enforceable limits on deployment. The larger option accepts the company's temporary promises and schedules another review next year.</p><p>Sales has circled the larger number. Imani has circled the word <em>enforceable</em>.</p><p>A restriction cannot become real because you say it confidently at this meeting. If you did not fund safeguards or preserve the originals, the smaller proposal must wait while the company changes course.</p><p>“A year is a long time to hold ourselves back,” Vale says.</p><p>Lena replies, “It is a long time to wait for your name to stop being a suspect.”</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X11") %> <%= PM.choices("X11") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X11 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_SMALL]] [[X_END_TEMP]] [[X12]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X12"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The cost of stopping</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X12") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X12</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Vale shuts the boardroom door. Without the expansion, the financing round may be repriced. A hiring freeze could become layoffs.</p><p>“You are asking people who did nothing wrong to lose their jobs,” he says.</p><p>Imani answers that residents who did nothing wrong are already paying. Lena says nothing. Some of the threatened jobs belong to her team.</p><p>You can explain the pause publicly and preserve the warning. You can try to keep it private while reassuring investors. Or, once, you can reverse course and proceed despite what you now know.</p><p>Vale places a removal resolution beside the revised forecast. “The board has obligations too.”</p><p>Stopping an expansion is within your authority. Remaining in office is not entirely within it.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X12") %> <%= PM.choices("X12") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X12 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X13]] [[X02]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X13"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The removal vote</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X13") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X13</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Five directors vote. Four entered the room expecting growth; Imani entered expecting accountability.</p><p>A viable restricted city contract could change the calculation. If you already secured it and funded the smaller operation, finance and the investor director can defend retaining you: less upside, but a business that still works.</p><p>Promises about a contract you never obtained cannot do that work now.</p><p>Vale asks whether you will maintain the suspension. The recorder clicks on. Lena waits outside, unable to vote on the decision that will determine whether her warning mattered.</p><blockquote>“For the minutes,” Vale says, “state your position.”</blockquote> </div> <%= PM.context("X13") %> <%= PM.choices("X13") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X13 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X14]] [[X15]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X14"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Still CEO at a smaller company</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X14") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X14</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has priced an independent custody review at $250,000 in company funds. Authorizing one commits that budget, or retains it if already funded; it is separate from your personal compensation.</p> <p>The vote is three to two. Imani, finance, and the investor director support the smaller operation. Vale calls the result a provisional mandate.</p><p>The full-expansion award disappears from the compensation schedule. The smaller contract still forecasts $400,000 in performance pay. So do several proposed installations. The company survives; the growth story becomes less attractive.</p><p>Outside the room, Lena tells you Nox's evidence is ready for review. The independent examiner needs the warning and comparison history.</p><p>You have kept the title by promising limits. You must now let someone outside the company test whether those limits and your public account are true.</p><p>Vale stops at your door. “There are things a company can acknowledge, and things it cannot afford to say.”</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X14") %> <%= PM.choices("X14") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X14 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X21]] [[X17]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X15"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Access revoked</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X15") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X15</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Your badge flashes red.</p><p>Inside, communications has already posted a statement thanking you for your leadership. It describes the transition as a renewed commitment to customers. Expansion resumes under interim management.</p><p>A security employee carries your coat downstairs. They look embarrassed. You suddenly have much less power than the person you were when you arrived.</p><p>On your personal phone, Lena writes: <em>Alex is still flagged. Nox's cache needs someone to explain the internal record. I kept my warning.</em></p><p>The severance offer follows a minute later. You cannot log in, change settings, or issue orders. What happens next depends on what you are prepared to say from outside.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X15") %> <%= PM.choices("X15") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X15 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X16]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X16"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The severance decision</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X16") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X16</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The offer is $250,000 in severance. Your expansion bonus and equity payout are gone. This is the remaining payment the board is asking you to protect.</p><p>The severance amount would pay for a long period without work. The agreement asks for silence and cooperation with the company's public account.</p><p>Your adviser circles the language. This fictional agreement is a pressure device in the story, not a description of current whistleblower law. Challenging it will still mean expense, uncertainty, and calls that potential employers may stop returning.</p><p>You have retained material you received while in office. Lena can authenticate her memo. Nox has observations from the device. Together those sources could reveal more than any of you can prove alone.</p><blockquote>Lena writes: “I am not asking you to save the company. I am asking whether your name on that memo means anything now.”</blockquote><p>You open the attachment again.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X16") %> <%= PM.choices("X16") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X16 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_SYSTEM]] [[X21]] [[X20]] [[X_END_LEAK]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X17"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Containment becomes abuse</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X17") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X17</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Vale calls the issue containment. Counsel calls it a preservation obligation. The people outside call it evidence.</p><p>“If this becomes the company versus one disgruntled engineer and a vandal, we can survive,” Vale says. “If it becomes our records versus our statements, we have a different problem.”</p><p>The proposed responses are on your desk. Use the network to monitor people around Nox. Remove contradictory records. Blame Lena and deny her warning. These are acts against people, not neutral communications strategies.</p><p>Counsel tells you to preserve relevant material. Vale waits until counsel leaves before adding, “The board will remember who protected it.”</p><p>You can still refuse. Refusal will not erase what you already approved.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X17") %> <%= PM.choices("X17") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X17 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X19]] [[X05]] [[X25]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X18"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The inquiry asks for originals</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X18") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X18</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has priced an independent custody review at $250,000 in company funds. Authorizing one commits that budget, or retains it if already funded; it is separate from your personal compensation.</p> <p>The inquiry does not accept a private correction as an answer to a public claim.</p><p>An examiner asks for the original observations, the comparison history, and the warning memo. “We need to establish what was known, by whom, and when.”</p><p>Communications drafts a response saying leadership had no reason to doubt the assessment. You know that is false.</p><p>A disclosure could cost the contract. Concealing records now would be a deliberate response to a concrete request for evidence. It is different from a delayed answer or an imperfect product.</p><p>There is a blank signature line beneath the statement.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X18") %> <%= PM.choices("X18") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X18 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X21]] [[X19]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X19"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Who still has a copy</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X19") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X19</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The company's response goes out. Outside, the inquiry starts matching dates, copies, and witnesses.</p><p>Nox's cache demonstrates that the device's assessment was contestable. It cannot, by itself, establish every conversation inside the company.</p><p>The investigators need something that links the warning to management's decisions. An independently retained record may survive an order to destroy the company copy. A threatened engineer may decide that silence is no longer protection.</p><p>You refresh the inquiry docket. This time the result depends on who else still has evidence, not on which explanation you would prefer to give.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X19") %> <%= PM.choices("X19") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X19 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X22]] [[X23]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X20"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The newsroom</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X20") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X20</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The journalist refuses the full archive.</p><p>“I need the warning, the comparison history, and a way to establish authenticity. I do not need to publish someone's clinic visits to explain your sales claim.”</p><p>Lena walks the verifier through her memo. Nox complains that redaction gives the company time to respond. The journalist says a story that cannot survive scrutiny gives it an easier escape.</p><p>You used to approve the company's wording. Now you are a source. You cannot demand the headline or control the timing.</p><p>A limited disclosure will leave some of the network invisible. A complete dump will make uninvolved people visible too.</p> <p>Nox has contacted Imani, a resident whose journeys appear in the cache. She allowed Nox to quote her reply: “I want this challenged too. But that clinic visit was mine. Helping your case does not mean handing my movements to everyone.” Nox says the full archive would be harder to dismiss. Imani has not agreed to that release.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X20") %> <%= PM.choices("X20") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X20 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X21]] [[X_END_LEAK]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X21"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Independent scrutiny</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X21") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X21</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Weeks later, the independent examiner publishes a finding. The advertised agreement among plate, face, and gait did not establish three independent confirmations.</p><p>The cache, original records, and engineer's explanation can now be compared. The identification no longer carries the certainty the company gave it. Authorities begin correcting Alex's case.</p><p>The report separates a product failure from decisions made after people knew about it. It does not pretend that a review itself convicts anyone.</p><p>For the first time, your public account can be tested against a record you do not control. The next consequences depend on what that record shows you actually did.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X21") %> <%= PM.choices("X21") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X21 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_ARREST]] [[X_END_SCAPE]] [[X_END_FIRED]] [[X24]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X22"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The surviving record</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X22") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X22</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Months pass. The inquiry obtains an authenticated copy that contradicts management's account.</p><p>The record does not merely show that an algorithm was wrong. It shows the warning, the response, and the actions taken while the company tried to protect its position.</p><p>Vale's statement says the board was misled by an individual executive. The document carefully avoids discussing the targets the board set or the protection it promised.</p><p>Investigators distinguish the misuse of the system from deliberate obstruction of their inquiry. Neither is repaired by replacing the person whose signature appears last.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X22") %> <%= PM.choices("X22") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X22 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_ARREST]] [[X_END_SCAPE]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X23"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The story holds for now</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X23") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X23</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The inquiry cannot authenticate the internal link it needs. Nox's cache is disputed. The company emphasizes its broken camera and describes the disclosure as an attack.</p><p>The contract closes.</p><p>Finance sends your bonus confirmation. In a separate tab, a case update still lists Alex as a suspect. There is no scene in which someone arrives to balance the two facts.</p><p>You know enough to supply the missing connection. Doing so would also make your own decisions visible.</p><p>Vale's message is brief: <em>Difficult week. Excellent leadership.</em></p> </div> <%= PM.context("X23") %> <%= PM.choices("X23") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X23 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_WIN]] [[X21]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X24"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The public hearing</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X24") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X24</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Finance has supplied the personal payout terms: $400,000 for the smaller binding deal, no expansion payout for withdrawal, or $1.4 million for the larger renewal. None measures what the city has lost.</p><p>At the hearing, Mara, the murdered investigator’s sister, speaks first. “I want the right person found. Certainty about the wrong person is not progress.”</p><p>The mechanic describes the verified lead that brought his van home. Alex's advocate describes missed work, copied flags, and the effort required to challenge a screen.</p><p>The council asks what you will actually fund. A smaller footprint can pay for independent access, review, and correction. Withdrawing the biometric expansion would leave existing cameras and records to be addressed separately. Voluntary promises would preserve more revenue, while leaving the next board room to reverse them.</p><p>No answer makes the earlier events disappear. The question is what you are prepared to make harder to repeat.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X24") %> <%= PM.choices("X24") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X24 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_SMALL]] [[X_END_PAUSE]] [[X_END_TEMP]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C01"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The roadside stop</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C01") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C01</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>You are thinking about your shift when the lights appear behind you. Two cars stop. The officer does not ask whether you know why.</p><p>“Is this your vehicle?”</p><p>It is. You are Alex, a working student. Last night you were near the transit station, then across town. You have never met the municipal investigator whose photograph the officer shows you.</p><details class="evidence" open><summary>The officer’s next questions</summary><p>“Where were you last night? Who else drives this car?” You explain that your brother sometimes borrows it. The officer checks a tablet.</p><p>“We have a facial comparison too.” The image is distant and blurred. Then a clip of someone walking, favoring one leg. You hurt your ankle last week.</p><blockquote>“We have more than your plate.”</blockquote><p>None of it puts you at the murder. On the screen, the three labels sit beside one another as if agreement makes them proof.</p></details><p>The questioning continues. You are innocent in every version of what happens next. No wording can change that.</p> <p>Earlier today, a public appeal showed Mara, the investigator’s sister, holding a family photograph. “He was meant to call on Sunday. We need an answer we can trust.” The image stays with you after the report ends.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C01") %> <%= PM.choices("C01") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C01 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C02]] [[C06]] [[C10]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C02"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The interview room</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C02") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C02</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The interview room has no clock you can see. Your manager has called three times.</p><p>You remember buying food after leaving the station. The investigator says the camera timestamp places you somewhere else. You ask whether the clocks agree. He asks why your account has changed.</p><p>A clip plays again. A person favors one leg. You say plenty of people limp. The investigator marks something in the report.</p><blockquote>“Help us eliminate you, Alex. Give us the complete picture.”</blockquote><p>Your phone contains a location history, messages, and visits you never expected to explain here. There is also a night-shift worker across town who may remember you. You can offer more data, seek that witness, or stop expanding the disclosure.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C02") %> <%= PM.choices("C02") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C02 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C03]] [[C06]] [[C04]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C03"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The data spread</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C03") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C03</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The upload gives the investigator part of the timeline. It also gives him places you did not mention because they had nothing to do with the murder.</p><p>He stops at a visit to a friend's apartment. “Who is this?”</p><p>Your friend has their own reasons to avoid becoming a name in an investigation. The record shows where you were, not why, who was home, or what any of it meant.</p><p>You had imagined a larger dataset would make the picture clearer. Now it contains more things for someone else to interpret.</p><p>Your friend agrees to a limited contact if you want it. Alternatively, you can ask the reviewer to focus on the relevant window. That request will not retrieve the broad history you already supplied.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C03") %> <%= PM.choices("C03") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C03 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C04]] [[C07]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C04"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The reluctant witness</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C04") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C04</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The worker remembers you. You joked about the late bus while buying food, well away from the murder location.</p><p>They find a receipt and check the time against the shop's records. It is stronger than your memory alone.</p><p>Then they ask whether a statement will bring police to their workplace. Their supervisor dislikes disruptions. Their immigration history, relationships, and private movements are not evidence about you, but they worry about what else someone might ask.</p><blockquote>“I will confirm the purchase,” they say. “That is all I can offer.”</blockquote><p>The statement can be narrow. It can still cost someone courage to give it. You can use the relevant evidence or seek another route without making this person your solution.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C04") %> <%= PM.choices("C04") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C04 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C05]] [[C06]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C05"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A contradiction survives</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C05") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C05</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The reviewer compares the receipt with the statement. For the first time, something from outside the camera system interrupts the camera system's story.</p><p>“This does not fit the assessment,” she says.</p><p>You want to ask why that was not the first question. Instead, you ask what happens to your name.</p><p>She can begin a local correction. She cannot guarantee that every recipient of the original alert will immediately receive or act on it.</p><p>Your next shift starts tomorrow. You can concentrate on a written local remedy, or use the contradiction to ask how the identification was built in the first place.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C05") %> <%= PM.choices("C05") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C05 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C09]] [[C08]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C06"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The first request</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C06") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C06</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The police desk says the identity assessment comes from Horizon. Customer support says the police own the investigation. The review office says it cannot disclose a process it does not possess.</p><p>You receive three reference numbers and no original comparison.</p><p>“I am asking why you think it is me,” you say.</p><p>The response repeats the assessment. It does not show how the images were selected or what contradicted them.</p><p>A direct request leaves a paper trail. An advocate might know whom to press. An independent witness could challenge the result without waiting for the company to explain itself.</p><p>Limiting your disclosure is not evidence of guilt. It has simply not made the institutions inspect their own assumption.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C06") %> <%= PM.choices("C06") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C06 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C07]] [[C08]] [[C04]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C07"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A conclusion instead of evidence</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C07") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C07</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The response arrives with your surname misspelled. Attached is a page headed <em>Identity assessment: probable match</em>.</p><p>The candidate images are absent. So is the comparison history. You asked for the reasons and received the conclusion.</p><p>Another afternoon disappears. Your manager says someone reliable needs to cover the next shift. You do not know how to explain that you have been trying to become a person a computer no longer suspects.</p><p>The authorities' next review deadline is earlier than the promised response to your follow-up.</p><p>You can ask an advocate to intervene, take the incomplete record to a journalist, or protect what remains of your working week. None of those choices changes what the authorities should have established before accusing you.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C07") %> <%= PM.choices("C07") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C07 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C08]] [[C10]] [[C22]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C08"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The advocate’s office</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C08") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C08</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Mara, the advocate, draws three boxes on paper: observation, interpretation, action.</p><p>“They keep giving you the third as proof of the first two.”</p><p>If the witness and receipt are already available, she can use them for immediate local relief. Otherwise, the institutional request remains stalled.</p><p>There is another development. An anti-surveillance hacker called Nox claims to have recovered comparison history from a damaged pilot camera. An independent verifier has offered to examine it.</p><p>Mara does not ask you to trust Nox. She asks whether someone with no stake in the company's claim should inspect the evidence.</p><p>Residents are also organizing a demonstration. You can join them without agreeing on everything they want.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C08") %> <%= PM.choices("C08") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C08 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C09]] [[C13]] [[C11]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C09"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Cleared here but flagged elsewhere</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C09") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C09</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>You carry the correction in your bag. It says the local identification is no longer supported.</p><p>Days later, another officer checks a different system. Your name still carries the original association.</p><blockquote>“That is not what I have here.”</blockquote><p>You show the letter. Eventually you leave. The other office was acting on an old record; you did not become guilty between databases.</p><p>At home you photograph the correction so it will always be on your phone. It feels like preparing for weather.</p><p>You can pursue every known recipient, tell the public what happened, or return to daily life with the local letter and hope the next screen has caught up.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C09") %> <%= PM.choices("C09") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C09 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C20]] [[C10]] [[C_END_FLAG]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C10"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The public meeting</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C10") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C10</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The community room is crowded. The murdered investigator's sister wants a reliable investigation. A mechanic wants the cameras that helped recover his van. A mother wants to know why her daughter's movements are stored at all.</p><p>Nox stands at the back. “You are arguing over who gets the keys. I am asking why they built the cage.”</p><p>A journalist, Jules, asks whether you have anything beyond the final assessment. You explain the missing records. They offer to investigate.</p><p>Outside, people prepare to march toward the cameras. Some carry signs calling for oversight. Others want the devices gone tonight.</p><p>You can join the demonstration or work with Jules directly. Evidence should not require proving you are willing to destroy something.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C10") %> <%= PM.choices("C10") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C10 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C11]] [[C13]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C11"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">At the cameras</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C11") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C11</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The chant changes as the crowd reaches the cameras.</p><p>You hear a crash. Nox and several others destroy a unit, then remove it. Someone cheers. Someone else says their shop was robbed last month and asks who is protecting them now.</p><p>Nox looks toward you. “This is the thing that did it.”</p><p>It is also an object. Your accusation involved software, sales claims, institutional choices, and people. Breaking the object will not automatically break the record.</p><p>You can help, refuse and document what happens, or leave. If you participate, that act will be your responsibility. It will not make the original murder accusation true.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C11") %> <%= PM.choices("C11") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C11 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C12]] [[C13]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C12"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The aftermath of the protest</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C12") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C12</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>By morning, the news is showing the broken camera more often than the disputed identification.</p><p>Nox says the removed unit contained a diagnostic cache. They have recovered candidate comparisons and timestamps. The material might reveal what the company's confident label concealed.</p><p>A neighbor says the destruction made the street feel less safe. Another says it is the first time anyone has made the company listen.</p><p>You receive an offer to meet Nox. You can hear them directly, or ask an independent intermediary to handle the material. The evidence does not become reliable just because its owner opposes the people who accused you.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C12") %> <%= PM.choices("C12") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C12 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C13]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C13"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The recovered cache</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C13") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C13</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Nox scrolls backward through the comparison history. The face candidate was selected after the vehicle association. The gait clip was selected within the same narrowed search.</p><p>“They sold three confirmations,” Nox says. “Look at where the other two came from.”</p><p>The cache challenges the identification. It does not yet prove every claim Nox makes about the company. A separate engineer's memo could establish what leadership knew if someone authenticates it.</p><p>Then another file opens. An unrelated person's movements. A clinic. A home. A pattern that was never meant for you.</p><blockquote>“Publish it all,” Nox says. “Let everyone see what unsafe means.”</blockquote><p>Your innocence and Nox's campaign overlap here. They are not the same objective.</p> <p>Nox has contacted Imani, a resident whose journeys appear in the cache. She allowed Nox to quote her reply: “I want this challenged too. But that clinic visit was mine. Helping your case does not mean handing my movements to everyone.” Nox says the full archive would be harder to dismiss. Imani has not agreed to that release.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C13") %> <%= PM.choices("C13") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C13 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C14]] [[C15]] [[C16]] [[C17]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C14"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Verification takes time</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C14") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C14</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The verifier will not call the cache authentic because its contents are convenient.</p><p>They compare timestamps with independent records and seek an engineer who can explain the sequence. Nox says this gives the company time. Mara says a claim that survives scrutiny is worth more than a dramatic screenshot.</p><p>The appointment arrives after the authorities' next review deadline.</p><p>If the witness has already corroborated your evening, that evidence can keep the immediate case from escalating while the technical work continues. Without it, the authorities are still relying on the disputed assessment.</p><p>You have made the same reasonable request in either situation. The institution's timetable changes what happens to you while it is answered.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C14") %> <%= PM.choices("C14") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C14 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C20]] [[C18]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C15"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The journalist’s desk</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C15") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C15</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Jules has contacted an engineer. The verifier checks the recovered history against the engineer's retained memo and relevant originals. The contradiction is now more than Nox's assertion.</p><p>The newsroom removes unrelated movements from its publication. The company sends demands and questions the source. Jules answers the factual questions and keeps working.</p><p>There is one decision the reporter cannot make for you. Will your face and name lead the story?</p><p>Speaking publicly makes it harder to reduce you to a technical incident. Withholding your identity protects a boundary, although people who know the case may still infer who you are.</p><p>“You can give us evidence without giving us every part of your life,” Jules says.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C15") %> <%= PM.choices("C15") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C15 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C21]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C16"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The release cannot be recalled</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C16") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C16</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The archive is online before breakfast.</p><p>People find the contradiction involving you. They also find a clinic visit, a relationship, a place someone thought they could go without explaining it. Copies spread before anyone finishes checking them.</p><p>A stranger writes that you have been vindicated. Another calls the files fake. Neither has authenticated the evidence.</p><p>Nox says the company's claim of safety is finished. You look at a message from someone whose movements were published: <em>What did I do to deserve this?</em></p><p>You cannot recall the release. You can still help verify the relevant part or seek a narrow remedy after that verification is completed.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C16") %> <%= PM.choices("C16") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C16 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C21]] [[C20]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C17"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Personal relief and Nox’s agenda</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C17") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C17</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Nox agrees to send your relevant records to Mara.</p><p>“But I am not closing the campaign because you get your letter.”</p><p>You ask them to hold the archive with an independent custodian and let a verified, redacted report demonstrate the failure. Nox considers it: a credible investigation could reach people who would dismiss a dump.</p><p>Or you can accept the personal help and leave their wider plans alone. Nox has made clear what they intend to do.</p><p>You do not control the hacker. Accepting help is not a contract that turns someone else's agenda into your own.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C17") %> <%= PM.choices("C17") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C17 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C14]] [[C16]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C18"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Detained</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C18") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C18</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Several days later, your belongings are placed in a bag. The authorities continue relying on the disputed assessment while verification is unfinished.</p><p>The room you are given has less space than the interview room. Your ability to call witnesses, reach records, and explain the delay to work has narrowed with it.</p><p>This fictional jurisdiction has turned an unresolved assessment into detention. That failure belongs to the institution. It is not proof that you should have disclosed more or answered more politely.</p><p>The technical review is still pending. Someone outside must carry it forward. An earlier ally can do that work. Without one, you can ask a review officer to forward the request, although it will be slower and lonelier.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C18") %> <%= PM.choices("C18") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C18 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C19]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C19"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Someone carries the evidence</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C19") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C19</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>An engineer finally explains the comparison sequence to the verifier. The memo matches the recovered history. The three apparent confirmations were not independent.</p><p>You hear the finding through another person. It is strange to learn that evidence about your own face has become available without being able to see the screen.</p><p>The relevant material can go to the deciding office. It can also support a redacted public investigation. Either use requires you to let other people continue with a story you wish had ended at the roadside.</p><p>You can decline further use for now. The authorities would still be responsible for the accusation, but no authenticated correction would reach the deciding office before this part of your story ends.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C19") %> <%= PM.choices("C19") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C19 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C20]] [[C21]] [[C22]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C20"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A correction is not a reset</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C20") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C20</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The reviewer places a correction beside the original alert. The unsupported identification is no longer being treated as an established fact in your local case.</p><p>“Who else received it?” you ask.</p><p>She opens a recipient list. Correcting one office and reaching every known recipient are separate tasks. Neither can promise that no unknown copy exists.</p><p>You can take the local relief and stop. You can keep pursuing the recipients. Or you can use independently verified evidence to ask for restrictions on the system itself.</p><p>Each additional step consumes time you expected to spend living your life. The people who created the record are being paid to process it. You are missing another shift.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C20") %> <%= PM.choices("C20") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C20 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C_END_FLAG]] [[C_END_CASE]] [[C21]] [[C_END_DAMAGE]] [[C_END_EXPOSED]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C21"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A hearing rather than a rescue</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C21") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C21</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The hearing starts weeks after the accusation. It cannot rescue the time already lost.</p><p>Mara, the investigator’s sister from the public appeal, speaks. “I wanted answers. I did not ask you to make someone fit the machine.” The mechanic describes the van that came home. Your advocate explains the comparison history.</p><p>Imani asks who is responsible when perfectly accurate movements end up in the wrong hands. No one can answer that question with a better recognition rate.</p><p>The council can suspend biometric expansion and fund independent scrutiny. It can also concentrate on correcting your case while leaving the wider arrangement largely intact.</p><p>At the microphone, your statement is shorter than the experience that made it necessary.</p> <% if (story.state.privacy === "public") { %><p>Imani has seen her journeys reposted. “I supported checking the evidence. I did not agree to this.”</p><% } else if (story.state.privacy === "broad") { %><p>Imani asks what happened to unrelated journeys submitted privately. “A review file has readers too. Who limits what they can do with it?”</p><% } else { %><p>Imani acknowledges that this route kept unrelated journeys out of wider disclosure. “That matters. Now tell me why they were collected in the first place.”</p><% } %> </div> <%= PM.context("C21") %> <%= PM.choices("C21") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C21 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C_END_PUBLIC]] [[C_END_CASE]] [[C_END_DAMAGE]] [[C_END_EXPOSED]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C22"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE CIVILIAN / RIVERTON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The unresolved file</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C22") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>C22</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The accusation is still there when you try to do something ordinary.</p><p>You open your work schedule. A shift has disappeared. You start to explain and realize you have told the story so often that it now sounds rehearsed.</p><p>No new evidence has made you guilty. The deciding institution still lacks, delays, or refuses the material that would challenge its first conclusion.</p><p>If an independent advocate has not yet taken up the case, there is one more route you can try. You can also stop here. An unresolved ending is not a confession.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C22") %> <%= PM.choices("C22") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C22 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[C08]] [[C_END_SYSTEM]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_WIN"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The company wins</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_WIN") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_WIN</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The bonus clears before the case does.</p><p>The expansion goes ahead. The company calls the camera recovery an attack, the contradictory assessment an unverified allegation, and your leadership decisive.</p><p>Alex remains under suspicion. The official process still lacks authenticated internal evidence. Future scrutiny is possible. It is not guaranteed.</p><p>You have not beaten a villain. You have given the board the result it rewarded.</p><blockquote>In the annual report, this year becomes a line that slopes upward.</blockquote> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_WIN") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_WIN") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_WIN / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_ARREST"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Evidence survives</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_ARREST") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_ARREST</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">This time, the record has your name on it.</p><p>Months after authenticated evidence reaches investigators, you are arrested in connection with knowing obstruction. The arrest is not a conviction. The investigation concerns acts of concealment, not the mere existence of an imperfect technology.</p><p>The identification of Alex is corrected. That correction does not return the lost shifts or erase the encounters.</p><p>The board announces cooperation and appoints new leadership. A company can sacrifice an executive without abandoning the incentives that executive served.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_ARREST") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_ARREST") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_ARREST / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_SCAPE"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The board’s scapegoat</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_SCAPE") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_SCAPE</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">A leadership change is announced as a system change.</p><p>Authenticated records expose abusive conduct. The board removes you and says the company has turned a page. Investigators continue their work; firing is not a criminal verdict.</p><p>Your replacement inherits the contracts, the cameras, and the expectations.</p><p>Alex's identification is challenged with evidence the company can no longer dismiss. Whether the wider business changes will require more than your empty chair.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_SCAPE") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_SCAPE") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_SCAPE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_SMALL"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A smaller system</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_SMALL") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_SMALL</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The company survives a smaller number.</p><p>The agreement funds independent access, complaint support, and enforceable restrictions. Fewer devices are deployed. Projected returns fall. You remain CEO for now.</p><p>Relevant records support correction of Alex's case. Earlier collection still exists, and oversight will require people with time, authority, and funding.</p><p>The system is less able to harm people in some specific ways. Residents can still reasonably question whether it should track them at all.</p><blockquote>The next board pack arrives with a proposal to “revisit growth constraints.”</blockquote> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_SMALL") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_SMALL") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_SMALL / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_TEMP"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A temporary compromise</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_TEMP") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_TEMP</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Temporary becomes renewable.</p><p>The city accepts a larger short renewal supported by voluntary promises. Some immediate practices improve. The next budget reduces the review team. Exceptions become easier to authorize.</p><p>The identification dispute remains a problem the company says it is handling. Its resolution depends on whether independent evidence actually reached reviewers in your route.</p><p>No single meeting reverses the compromise. Each meeting removes a small cost from the company and returns it to someone outside.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_TEMP") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_TEMP") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_TEMP / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_SYSTEM"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The system outlives you</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_SYSTEM") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_SYSTEM</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The building still lights up at night.</p><p>You accept the severance and stop supplying authentication. Your successor restores the expansion timetable. The company describes your departure as continuity.</p><p>Lena and Nox may still get evidence examined. You have left that work to them.</p><p>You lost the position for resisting, then protected your exit. Alex's case is not repaired by your private knowledge that the system was wrong.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_SYSTEM") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_SYSTEM") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_SYSTEM / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_FIRED"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Fired but the record is corrected</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_FIRED") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_FIRED</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">You lose the office. The evidence keeps moving.</p><p>Your retained material and Lena's explanation help authenticate the recovered history. Authorities correct Alex's identification. Independent scrutiny continues.</p><p>The company has already replaced you. Work becomes harder to find. The people who praised decisive leadership now ask whether you can be trusted to keep difficult matters internal.</p><p>There is no job offer attached to doing this. There is a person whose case no longer rests on the certainty you helped sell.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_FIRED") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_FIRED") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_FIRED / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_LEAK"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The archive escapes</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_LEAK") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_LEAK</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The archive stops belonging to anyone.</p><p>Nox publishes the complete retained material. Company decisions become visible alongside uninvolved residents' movements. Verification of the relevant evidence continues; exposure alone does not settle Alex's case.</p><p>You wanted the truth to become impossible to suppress. You also made other people's private lives impossible to retrieve.</p><p>Being fired did not remove every form of power you held. Some of it was still inside the files.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_LEAK") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_LEAK") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_LEAK / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X_END_PAUSE"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / EXECUTIVE</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Expansion stops here</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X_END_PAUSE") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>X_END_PAUSE</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Expansion stops. The past remains installed.</p><p>You withdraw the biometric expansion and fund correction. The city will need separate decisions about existing cameras, retained records, and downstream copies.</p><p>Alex receives relief from an accusation that should not have carried the confidence your product gave it. The victim's family still needs a reliable investigation.</p><p>The pause is a real change. Keeping it in place will require people who are willing to defend it when the next forecast arrives.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X_END_PAUSE") %> <%= PM.choices("X_END_PAUSE") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X_END_PAUSE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_EXPOSED"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Cleared but exposed</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_EXPOSED") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_EXPOSED</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Your name is cleared.<br>Your boundaries are not restored.</p><p>The authorities correct the murder identification. You did not become innocent when the paperwork changed; the paperwork finally began to reflect it.</p><p>The information you disclosed still exists outside your control. The exact audience depends on whether you supplied broad private records or the archive became public.</p><p>Your next shift begins at seven. You set an alarm, then wonder who else knows where you sleep.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_EXPOSED") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_EXPOSED") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_EXPOSED / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_FLAG"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Cleared here but still flagged</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_FLAG") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_FLAG</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Keep the letter with you.</p><p>The local file is corrected. Some recipients still retain the original association. You save the letter on your phone and put a paper copy in the glove compartment.</p><p>You are working again. You still slow down when you see a camera, then feel angry at yourself for doing it.</p><p>The immediate accusation has changed. The effort of proving that it changed has become part of your daily life.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_FLAG") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_FLAG") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_FLAG / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_CASE"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The case breaks open</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_CASE") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_CASE</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The contradiction finally travels.</p><p>Supported correction reaches every known recipient of the original flag. The inquiry can examine why conflicting evidence was presented as certainty. Nobody promises that every unknown copy has vanished.</p><p>You count the missed shifts. The total is smaller than the loss.</p><p>A friend says it must feel good to have the system work. You think of the witness, the advocate, the verifier, and all the people who had to make it stop insisting.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_CASE") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_CASE") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_CASE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_DAMAGE"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Innocent of one crime</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_DAMAGE") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_DAMAGE</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">Innocent of the murder.<br>Responsible for a different choice.</p><p>The murder identification is corrected. A separate allegation remains concerning your participation in destroying a camera.</p><p>Those are different facts. The later damage does not justify the earlier accusation.
