The earlier accusation does not erase the damage.</p><p>You wanted something solid to push back against. The broken camera turned out to be easier to remove than the records it helped create.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_DAMAGE") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_DAMAGE") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_DAMAGE / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_SYSTEM"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The system keeps its story</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_SYSTEM") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_SYSTEM</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The file closes. The accusation does not.</p><p>The evidence has not reached, or has not persuaded, the institution controlling your case. You remain innocent. The story ends before the institution acts like that matters.</p><p>Someone else opens the assessment on a screen. They see a plate, a face, a gait comparison. They do not see the afternoons, unanswered requests, or costs that brought you here.</p><blockquote>Three labels look like agreement.</blockquote> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_SYSTEM") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_SYSTEM") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_SYSTEM / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="C_END_PUBLIC"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">OUTCOME / CIVILIAN</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Public victory and private loss</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("C_END_PUBLIC") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">OUTCOME<span>C_END_PUBLIC</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p class="lead">The expansion is suspended.<br>You still have to go home.</p><p>The council funds independent review and halts new biometric deployment. It is a real public change, built from evidence and people willing to carry it.</p><p>Your lost time does not come back. The relationships, privacy, and work affected along your route need their own repair. Public recognition, where you accepted it, is not something the council can switch off.</p><p>On the way home, a camera on the existing network follows the road. The vote did not remove it.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("C_END_PUBLIC") %> <%= PM.choices("C_END_PUBLIC") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / C_END_PUBLIC / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[REFLECTION]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="REFLECTION"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">A NEAR-FUTURE SURVEILLANCE THRILLER</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Who carried the cost</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("REFLECTION") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>REFLECTION</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <%= PMFinal.summary() %> <%= PMFinal.assessment() %> <p class="lead">A result is not the same as a repair.</p><p>The record below reflects this run. Your self-assessment is not a score assigned by the game and no promise that the people rewarded made good decisions.</p> <div id="outcome-record"><%= PM.reflection() %></div> <div class="questions"><h2>Before you leave</h2><ol><li>What evidence did your role control?</li><li>Who paid for the outcome you obtained?</li><li>If every plate, face, and walking pattern were identified perfectly, what would still be wrong?</li></ol></div> <p>The other perspective begins independently. It may reveal a cost your first role could not see.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("REFLECTION") %> <%= PM.choices("REFLECTION") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / REFLECTION / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[ROLE]] [[C01]] [[X01]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X25"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">A market for silence</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X25") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X25</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The outside firm calls it a confidence campaign. Its presentation treats Alex’s challenge as a threat to the financing round.</p><p>For $300,000 of company money, it proposes pressing officials to keep the accusation active and portraying independent review as an attack on public safety. Finance says the campaign would reduce your projected personal payout by $100,000.</p><p>Counsel closes the deck. “We can provide truthful records and advocate a policy. This proposal asks us to keep an innocent person under pressure so the contradiction stays quiet. You cannot purchase a prosecution or order an arrest. That does not make an attempt to obstruct review harmless.”</p><p>The chair says delay could still save the deal. A preserved warning or an employee willing to explain it could also make this invoice evidence of what you intended.</p><p>The proposal is still unsigned. You can authorize it or stop it here.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X25") %> <%= PM.choices("X25") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X25 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X26]] [[X05]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X26"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">Pressure reaches the case</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X26") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X26</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>The campaign begins. Officials receive the company’s demands and a selective account of the assessment. The police and reviewing authority still make their own decisions; your payment cannot dictate a lawful outcome.</p><p>It nevertheless changes the pressure surrounding those decisions. An update from the public agency reports that Alex has been detained while a challenge that should have received independent scrutiny is delayed. Their lost freedom is not a line in the campaign budget.</p><p>Inside the company, people recognize the gap between the warning and the message being promoted. Whether outsiders can establish that gap depends on what survived earlier decisions.</p><p>An inquiry asks for records. Money bought pressure. It did not buy control over every copy.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X26") %> <%= PM.choices("X26") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X26 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X27]] [[X23]] --><div class="scene" data-scene="X27"> <div class="scene-heading"><div class="kicker">THE EXECUTIVE / HORIZON</div> <h1 id="scene-title" tabindex="-1">The invoice becomes evidence</h1></div> <div class="game-layout"><%= PMVisual.stage("X27") %><div class="story-panel"><div class="dialogue-label">CASE NARRATIVE<span>X27</span></div><div class="prose" tabindex="-1"> <p>Months later, an independent examiner aligns three records: the engineer’s warning, the company’s instructions, and the campaign invoice. Preserved originals or the engineer’s retained copy supply the connection that a technical cache alone could not.</p><p>The company did not merely describe an uncertain product. Its leadership authorized pressure intended to suppress a meaningful challenge to an accusation it knew was unsupported.</p><p>The deciding authority corrects Alex’s identification. The time spent detained cannot be returned. The board removes you, announcing that the problem was one executive.</p><p>After a separate investigation, authorities seek your arrest for knowing obstruction in this fictional jurisdiction. Ordinary policy advocacy is not the accusation. The documented attempt to interfere with review is.</p> </div> <%= PM.context("X27") %> <%= PM.choices("X27") %> <div class="scene-end">RV-04 / X27 / FICTIONAL SCENARIO</div> </div></div></div> <!-- Twine map links: [[X_END_ARREST]] -->
